Germany / Austria / Switzerland · Last updated: 2026-09-01

Source: https://cordis.europa.eu/data/cordis-HORIZONprojects-csv.zip (official CORDIS bulk dataset)
Scope: DE, AT, CH
Known limitations:
  • Website info is frequently missing/stale in CORDIS - verify manually via the 'Website Search Link' column.
  • Outside of EIC Accelerator, the exact funding amount per company is not broken out separately by CORDIS.
  • CORDIS only covers EU-funded projects; AI companies funded by VC/private equity are not in this list.
  • The 'Scientific/Technical Domain' column is CORDIS's own EuroSciVoc classification, not an official business sector (NACE/SIC) - CORDIS does not provide that data.
